name: Fillion's Mission
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for saving Fillion, adventurer. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is. Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret. As ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 10 to 12, 3,765 XP in all.

quests.name: The Missing Scholar
quests.objectiveText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.

quests.name: Fillion's Mission
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

quests.name: Catching Wind
quests.objectiveText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there.

quests.name: Avenged Tenfold
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

quests.name: In Service of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
